entries: {SOMEONE:!plural} came to {place} {MANNER} bearing {THING}, and asked for {first}
{DISASTER:strikes} fell on {place}, and the {rival} named {first} the cause
{first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, bound with an old ward
the {rival} called {place} to war, and {first} was named to {DO_THING} {THING} {DEADLINE}
an old enemy, {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, rode into {place} {MANNER} with {THING}
{first} was chosen to {DO_THING} {THING} before {DISASTER:strikes} fell on {place}
the ward over {landmark} failed, and {SOMEONE} crawled out {MANNER}
{first} swore an oath to {SOMEONE:human,!plural} in exchange for {PRIZE:!inner}
the dead walked at {landmark}, and {first} alone knew where {THING} lay
